name: Noah
bio: Noah was a daughter of Zelophehad, of the tribe of Manasseh. Her father died in the wilderness leaving no sons, only her and her four sisters — Mahlah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah. Together they stood before Moses, the priest Eleazar, and the whole congregation, asking that their father's inheritance not disappear simply because he had no son; the LORD granted their request and decreed that when a man died without a son, his inheritance would pass to his daughters (Numbers 27:1-11). Afterward, Noah and her sisters married within their own clan as God commanded, so that the inheritance remained within the tribe of Manasseh (Numbers 36:10-12).
